sectors.name: Mining & Energy
themes: China's fiscal stimulus and infrastructure push are structurally boosting Indonesian thermal coal and nickel demand, with CUAN and BUMI benefiting from direct export linkages and capacity expansions.

sectors.ai: Aggressively overweight Indonesia coal and nickel plays: CUAN's +12.5% and BUMI's +9.5% signal a structural re-rating on China's stimulus-driven commodity demand and Indonesia's downstream policy moat. Rotate into COAL and DEWA for leveraged exposure to thermal coal export quotas and nickel smelter margins, as US rate cuts further compress EM risk premiums.

Southeast Asia's grid modernization push, led by PLN's $20B transmission upgrade, structurally lifts utility-scale battery and smart-grid stocks such as CEG and 373220.
sectors.ai: Indonesia's renewables rally signals a structural pivot: buy CDIA and NRG on their 6%+ surges, as policy tailwinds from the new Prabowo administration's green energy push and US IRA-linked demand for nickel-based storage create a durable catalyst. Exit ESSA on its 5.65% spike, as coal-to-gas switching risks fade with LNG price volatility.
